name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - Après le § 13 - Am 13
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 13b. Calls for the creation within the ESF+ of a specific budget line for the eradication of poverty and social exclusion, with EUR 7 142 857 143 in commitment appropriations, aimed at supporting measures to eradicate poverty and social exclusion by 2035, reduce inequalities, promote decent living conditions and strengthen access to quality public services and adequate social protection; emphasises that this funding should not replace or reduce the specific funding dedicated to the European Child Guarantee;
